mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS hands, COALESCE(SUM(p.net), 0) AS net, COALESCE(SUM(p.insurance_net), 0) AS insurance_net, COALESCE(SUM(p.vpip), 0) AS vpip_hands, COALESCE(SUM(p.pfr), 0) AS pfr_hands FROM hand_player p JOIN hand h ON h.hand_id = p.hand_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND h.variant = #{variant}

SELECT p.hand_id AS hand_id, p.seat, p.hole_cards AS hole_cards, p.net, p.start_stack AS start_stack, p.end_stack AS end_stack, p.insurance_net AS insurance_net, h.variant, h.board, h.started_at AS started_at FROM hand_player p JOIN hand h ON h.hand_id = p.hand_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY h.started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.hand_id AS hand_id, p.hole_cards AS hole_cards, h.board FROM hand_player p JOIN hand h ON h.hand_id = p.hand_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND h.ended_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
